verdict.rationale: Proton Pass ships a CLI for scripts and CI/CD, so asking whether it offers a sandbox or test environment for agentic testing is a fair question. However, no evidence documents a sandbox, test account, or dry-run mode isolated from production data. Organizing items into separate vaults is an adjacent organizational feature, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
